dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate trailing edge characterized by a deep concave spline curvature between the posterior insertion and the sub-apex region.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a small pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 70-75 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge, showing slight convexity near the anterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The vertical pixel height of the fin is approximately 1.8 times its maximum horizontal base width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several small, irregular V-shaped notches are visible on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; distinct dark linear marks/scars are present on the flank ventral to the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant light-colored mottling and speckled pigmentation patterns are present along the posterior dorsal ridge and the base of the dorsal fin.
